projects.title: ASMR-3D
projects.subtitle: Master's thesis: localized 3D model editing with generative AI
projects.summary: A tool that lets anyone edit one specific part of an existing 3D model, while the rest stays exactly as it was.
projects.description: Editing a 3D model usually means learning Blender for months or letting an AI regenerate the whole thing and hoping it lands. My thesis explores a third way: paint over the part you want changed, describe it in one sentence, and only that region gets rebuilt.
highlights: Built a pipeline where users paint the region to change directly on the model and describe the edit in a single sentence
An LLM clarifies and rewrites the prompt, then four image proposals preview the result before any 3D work happens

Developed ASMR-3D: a method that aligns old and new models, selects the edited region by weighing three cues against each other in a voting scheme, and rebuilds only those parts with a thin blending zone
Unchanged geometry stayed roughly 27× closer to the original than full-model regeneration
User study with 14 participants, none with prior 3D editing experience: 'excellent' on five of six UEQ scales, and all 14 said they would use and recommend it again
